# Monta API v2 endpoints (HTTP only)

Every operation in the Monta API v2 spec that is not deprecated, in one file per tag listed below. The hosted MCP server serves v1 only, so none of these operations is an MCP tool. Use them in code the partner writes, which calls them over HTTP with its own credentials and the `Monta-Version: v2` header; the paths keep the `/api/v1` prefix. Never ask for a token or secret in the chat. v2 is in beta and may change without notice, see [API versioning](https://developer.monta.com/docs/api-versioning). The Operation ID column only identifies the operation in the spec. Deprecated operations are in `deprecated.md`.

Safety: **R** read-only, **M** mutating (confirm first), **D** destructive (confirm with the concrete target restated).
